programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: TALK ROOM
programme.desc: What is the true strength of the K-people leading the K-Wave? We invite the most talked-about figures—those who influence not just Korea but the world—into our studio for intimate one-on-one conversations. Through their stories, the secrets behind overcoming failure and achieving success, and even private small talk, we uncover what makes them extraordinary. When you listen to someone’s story, you enter their world. In this time of dialogue with the most Korean yet most global K-people, we step into the K-Universe.

programme.title: WITH SCIENCE, WE LIVE
programme.desc: Humanity has learned from the past, transcended the present, and dreamed of the future."With Science, We Live"explores the frontiers of science alongside some of the world’s leading thinkers, offering insights into what lies ahead and uncovering new possibilities.In an era of rapid change, where are we headed?As we navigate between the vast universe and the smallness of human existence, we reconsider the direction we must take.Now, in this very moment, we imagine the future shaped by our choices—and move forward toward it.

Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.desc: A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea. programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

SmartBiz Accelerators introduces a variety of domestic small and medium-sized companies that have achieved continuous growth based on the smart factory project provided by Samsung Electronics as well as gives information on the technological competitiveness and the outlook for the companies in the global market. #SmartBizAccelerators #ArirangTV #smartfactory #smartfactoryproject #competitiveness_of_manufacturing #strengthening_competitiveness_of_SMEs #expanding_into_overseas_markets #growth_into_globalbusiness

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

And the government has unveiled and promoted a roadmap "Manufacturing Innovation 3.0," as part of an effort to enhance the competitiveness of the domestic manufacturing sector. SmartBiz Accelerators introduces a variety of domestic small and medium-sized companies that have achieved continuous growth based on the smart factory project provided by Samsung Electronics as well as gives information on the technological competitiveness and the outlook for the companies in the global market. #SmartBizAccelerators #ArirangTV #smartfactory #smartfactoryproject #competitiveness_of_manufacturing #strengthening_competitiveness_of_SMEs #expanding_into_overseas_markets #growth_into_globalbusiness

programme.desc: Arirang Special features a variety of unique and special programs produced by Arirang TV. These exciting programs will open your eyes to a new part of the world.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: SmartBiz Accelerators
programme.desc: Along with the strengthened manufacturing capabilities of various countries all around the world, "Smart Factory" has garnered a lot of attention in the global market. And the government has unveiled and promoted a roadmap "Manufacturing Innovation 3.0," as part of an effort to enhance the competitiveness of the domestic manufacturing sector. Moreover, a domestic major company Samsung Electronics has provided a smart factory solution in order to boost mutual growth with small and medium-sized businesses. SmartBiz Accelerators introduces a variety of domestic small and medium-sized companies that have achieved continuous growth based on the smart factory project provided by Samsung Electronics as well as gives information on the technological competitiveness and the outlook for the companies in the global market. #SmartBizAccelerators #ArirangTV #smartfactory #smartfactoryproject #competitiveness_of_manufacturing #strengthening_competitiveness_of_SMEs #expanding_into_overseas_markets #growth_into_globalbusiness

programme.title: K-Sports Beyond
programme.desc: "Transcend the Limits of Sports — K-SPORTS BEYOND!“ Where the thrilling contest of sweat and passion meets the unrivaled innovation of Korea's sports industry. Beyond intuition, to precise data—transcending all limits! From real-time AI motion analysis and high-performance sportswear to protective gear, smart facilities, and next-gen fitness solutions, we set the new standard for the future of sports. Meet 20 promising Korean sports enterprises expanding onto the global stage! Our passionate hosts and international guests dive into everyday life and the field of play to verify, experience, and showcase the superior technology and craftsmanship of K-Sports in a 100% real variety show. Beyond innovation to a quantum leap! Running alongside the world, [K-Sports Beyond] begins now.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.desc: Cuando Medusa es secuestrada por un cruel prestamista, Kyros, exige que Hércules recupere un artefacto precioso y poderoso del inframundo a cambio de su vida.

programme.title: Atlantis: El precio de la esperanza
programme.desc: Los chicos corren por sus vidas cuando se convierten en presas de una brutal persecución. Su coraje se pone a prueba hasta el límite, hasta que llega un salvavidas de una fuente inesperada.

programme.title: Atlantis: Dolores de hambre
programme.desc: Jasón comete un error fatal al comer carne de sacrificio y comienza a exhibir un comportamiento extraño. Hércules y Pitágoras deben salvar a su amigo mientras las cosas se descontrolan.

programme.title: Atlantis: Tocado por los Dioses - Parte 1
programme.desc: Jasón recuerda su promesa a Circe y su sombría advertencia si no cumple con su pacto. No tiene más remedio que actuar: Jasón debe matar a la reina.

programme.title: Atlantis: Tocado por los Dioses - Parte 2
programme.desc: Pasífae sentencia a Ariadna a una espantosa ejecución. Con Jasón como su última esperanza, depende de él y sus amigos intentar salvar la vida de Ariadna.

programme.title: Atlantis: Un nuevo amanecer: Primera parte
programme.desc: Mientras el reino está al borde del colapso, la lucha por el poder es sangrienta y brutal. Con un futuro sombrío, solo hay una persona que puede ayudar: Jasón.

programme.title: Atlantis: Un nuevo amanecer: Segunda parte
programme.desc: Pasífae pone sitio a la Atlántida y la ciudad parece a punto de caer. La última esperanza restante recae en Jasón, Hércules y Pitágoras, pero están librando una batalla propia.

programme.title: Atlantis: Telemón
programme.desc: Mientras Jasón lucha por la gloria en el campo del torneo, Ariadna se embarca en su propia batalla privada. El suyo es un concurso de cabeza sobre corazón, pero solo ella puede decidir cuál triunfará.

programme.title: Atlantis: El matrimonio de las mentes verdaderas
programme.sub-title: El matrimonio de las mentes verdaderas
programme.desc: A medida que avanzan los planes para la boda real, Ariadna debe emprender un viaje a Egina, la tierra natal de Telemon. Pero Jasón no es el único que teme por la seguridad de la reina.

programme.title: Atlantis: El día de los Muertos
programme.desc: La pandilla se encuentra dispersa alrededor de una antigua necrópolis. Y pronto se dan cuenta de que no están solos: el espacio está repleto de un ejército mágico de muertos vivientes.

programme.title: Atlantis: Las hermanas grises
programme.desc: Mientras Ariadna yace en su lecho de muerte, la culpa de Jasón es casi insoportable. Decide hacer todo lo posible para salvarla y se embarca en una peligrosa búsqueda hacia lo desconocido.

programme.title: Atlantis: Un destino peor que la muerte
programme.sub-title: Un destino peor que la muerte
programme.desc: Cuando la noticia llega a Pasífae sobre el inminente matrimonio de Ariadna y Jasón, está aterrorizada de que Atlantis se pierda para siempre y decide hacer todo lo posible para detener la unión.

programme.title: Atlantis: La locura de Hércules
programme.desc: A medida que Pasífae aumenta su control sobre la Atlántida, el futuro parece sombrío. Hércules sabe que solo hay una forma de salvar a sus amigos: Medusa. ¿Es un riesgo que está dispuesto a correr?

programme.title: Atlantis: La mirada de la Gorgona
programme.desc: Pasífae se ha apoderado de Atlantis y solo una cosa es segura: se necesitará un sacrificio de proporciones inimaginables para arreglar las cosas.

programme.title: Atlantis: La muerte de la luz
programme.desc: La profecía del Oráculo se ha hecho realidad: las revelaciones sobre Pasífae han ennegrecido el corazón de Jasón. Desesperado por salvar a su amigo, Pitágoras parte en busca de ayuda.

programme.title: Farm 999
programme.desc: In Bedfordshire, a scorching summer’s day turns to chaos when flames rip through the countryside. Farmers and firefighters join forces in a desperate battle to contain a fast-moving field fire threatening homes and livelihoods. With dramatic footage filmed by farmer and YouTuber George Saunders, we hear first-hand from those who faced the blaze – including the crews who risked everything to stop it from spreading. In Leicestershire, a beloved horse is in danger after plunging into a freezing swimming pool. As panic rises, a specialist fire and rescue team race to save it, with the help of a local farmer, before it’s too late. Meanwhile, reporter Paul Colgan is in Northern Ireland to meet volunteers behind Operation Brockwatch – a groundbreaking scheme using hidden cameras to protect badgers from ruthless illegal hunters.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A flat in Clapham, a terrace in Kent and a bungalow in Stoke-on-Trent are all sold under the hammer. Jacqui, Martin and Dion meet the successful bidders, including a mother and daughter taking on their first family development and a part-time property developer who spends more than five times his original budget.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Antiques meet archaeology in this episode from West Sussex. In the village of Fishbourne, Natasha Raskin Sharp learns about the discovery of a huge Roman palace by workmen in the 1960s. In the company of curator Dr Rob Symmons, she hears how part of the palace and its treasures were unearthed over eight summers by hundreds of volunteers. One of the highlights is an exquisite mosaic featuring mythical sea creatures around which the owner – a high-ranking Roman – and his guests would have sat to eat meals. Another highlight is a partially smashed statue of Emperor Nero and a remarkably rare rabbit bone. Hoping to unearth their own treasures are two teams of bargain hunters at Ardingly antiques fair. In blue are cousins Michelle and Emma, and in red are golfing pals Linda and Yvonne. With expert Caroline Hawley by their side, the reds get off to an explosive start, eyeing up a pair of powder flasks. Meanwhile, Emma spots a West German pottery vase, but expert Thomas Forrester doubts that profits will bloom at auction. Wielding his gavel at the auction is Nick Hall; can the experts’ bonus buys bring home the big bucks?

programme.title: The Northumbria Mysteries
programme.desc: A torched van, a dead unidentified passenger and a missing driver. Much to Rose’s frustration, Joe can’t help but insert himself into a mystery that hits dangerously close to home.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Jonnie Irwin takes in the delights of Derbyshire with a couple from Leeds, who, with their fantastic budget, want to see a range of rural properties with all the trimmings. programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road

The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize.

Jessica Ure exposes rogue emergency traders, including the plumber boasting about ripping off his customers on social media. Armed with secret cameras, she catches exploitation in action and unravels the online trap drawing desperate customers in. As victims share their stories, she follows the trail to the people behind the operations.

programme.title: Return to Paradise
programme.desc: 1983. A young surfer leaves Dolphin Cove in pursuit of his dreams. Forty-three years later, his remains are found in the concrete by the ocean pool. But how is that possible when he left town before the concrete was even poured? Mackenzie has her work cut out, with decades separating the investigation from the crime. The grim discovery stirs painful memories of Philomena's past, forcing her to confront history and heartache. Glenn's no stranger to that as he struggles to let go of his feelings for Mack, all while her connection with his replacement Leo blooms.

For the occasions that call for something a bit different, there is Nigella's chicken shawarma with an array of spices, sauces and flatbreads. Inspired by a spit-roasted Lebanese kebab, Nigella's oven-roasted version is fun, tasty and prefect for feeding a crowd. There has to be chocolate in the balance and Nigella shares two of her latest treats - a glossy liquorice and blackcurrant chocolate cake and her chocolate chip cookie dough pots - freshly baked pots of gooey cookie dough served with a dollop of ice cream or creme fraiche.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Drohung der Drachen
programme.desc: Norm hat Geburtstag. Er verletzt sich lebensgefährlich an einem Korken. Diane lernt endlich die Mutter von Frasier kennen. Die ist zunächst sehr freundlich. Dann aber rät sie Diane, die Finger von Frasier zu lassen. Andernfalls werde sie Diane erschießen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der betörende Widerling
programme.desc: Sam will Diane eifersüchtig machen. Er tut so, als habe er in einem Hotel ein Doppelzimmer für sich und seine vermeintliche Geliebte bestellt. Carla erliegt kurzfristig dem eigenartigen Charme ihres Exgatten Nick, der eigentlich ein Fiesling ist.

programme.title: Cheers: Allergisch gegen wen?
programme.desc: Diane hat einen neuen Freund, den Psychiater Frasier Crane. Der ist ein Mann ganz nach ihrem Geschmack: kultiviert, gebildet und intelligent. Sie fühlt sich wohl bei ihm. Doch mit seiner Mentalität kommt sie nicht klar.

programme.title: Cheers: Südseeträume
programme.desc: Norm glaubt sich todkrank, weil der Doktor einen Schatten auf seinem Röntgenbild entdeckt. Es stellt sich heraus, dass es ein technischer Fehler war. Da beschließt Norm, sein Leben grundlegend zu ändern. Er will auf die Südseeinsel Bora-Bora auswandern.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Sache mit Amanda
programme.desc: Eigentlich versucht sich Norm stets seiner ehelichen Pflichten zu entziehen. Doch plötzlich zermartert er sich den Kopf, wie er sein Kind nennen könnte – sollte er denn jemals einen Sprössling zeugen.

programme.title: Cheers: Doktor Ludlows große Liebe
programme.desc: Diane und ihr neuer Freund bringen einen berühmten Mann ins Cheers: den Psychiater Ludlow. Der Doktor und Carla, die derbe Kellnerin, verlieben sich ineinander. Sie beginnen eine Romanze, die bei allen Stammgästen Erstaunen hervorruft.

programme.title: Cheers: Auf zur Schnepfenjagd!
programme.desc: Sam und Norm wollen zum Angeln.Plötzlich sind sie von Stammgästen aus dem Cheers umringt, die alle mitwollen. Auch Dianes neuer Freund Frasier entdeckt sein Herz für rauhe Männervergnügungen. Die anderen wollen dem Neuen einen Streich spielen.

programme.title: Cheers: Schlechte Verlierer
programme.desc: Dianes neuer Freund Frasier soll für ein halbes Jahr als Gastdozent nach Bologna. Diane ist begeistert: Frasier will, dass sie ihn begleitet. Dann fällt ihr Sam ein. Trotz der offiziellen Trennung spukt er Diane immer noch im Kopf herum.

programme.title: Cheers: Lehrerins Liebling
programme.desc: Diane bereist mit Frasier Europa. Sie hinterlässt auf Sams Anrufbeantworter die Nachricht, dass sie am nächsten Tag in Florenz heiraten wird. Wenige Stunden später sitzt Sam im Flieger: Er glaubt, Diane vor einer großen Dummheit bewahren zu müssen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Postraub von Boston
programme.desc: Sam nimmt an einer Sportveranstaltung zu Wohltätigkeitszwecken teil. Das gegnerische Team besteht aus ehemaligen Schönheitsköniginnen. Sam nimmt das Ganze etwas zu ernst: Er spielt das schwache Geschlecht in Grund und Boden – und bekommt Ärger mit Diane.

programme.title: Cheers: Sams künftige Ex-Frau
programme.desc: Sam hat sich entschlossen, zusammen mit Coach seinen High-School-Abschluss nachzumachen. Er hat überraschend gute Noten. Diane merkt als erste, dass er sie vor allem für außerschulische Leistungen mit der attraktiven Lehrerin bekommt.

programme.title: Cheers: Mit fremden Federn
programme.desc: Cliff ist krank. Gerne nimmt er Norms Angebot an, die Post für ihn zuzustellen. Leider wird der Aushilfsbriefträger von der Polizei geschnappt. Die beschuldigt ihn, die Briefe gestohlen und das Postgeheimnis gebrochen zu haben.

programme.title: Cheers: Carla und ihr Affe
programme.desc: Sam wird mit einer Wette konfrontiert, an die er sich nicht mehr ganz erinnern kann: Vor einem Jahr hatte er gewettet, dass er die Schauspielerin Jacqueline Bisset heiraten werde – sonst würde sein Wettpartner Eddie das Cheers bekommen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Rausschmeißer vom Dienst
programme.desc: Mädchen und Männersport – so lauten Sams Hauptinteressen. Doch als er die attraktive Reporterin Paula kennen lernt, will er dieser imponieren: Plötzlich brilliert Sam mit gebildeten Kommentaren zu Kunst und Kultur.

programme.title: Cheers: Anfang oder Ende?
programme.desc: Nick, Carlas Ex-Ehemann, kommt eines Abends völlig fertig ins Cheers: sein blondes Dummchen Loretta hat ihn sitzen gelassen. Nun steht er ohne einen Cent da. Sam gibt ihm einen Putzjob im Cheers.

programme.title: Cheers: Mamis Leidenschaft
programme.desc: Norm hat einen neuen Job bekommen: Er soll in seiner Firma überflüssig gewordenen Kollegen eröffnen, dass die Geschäftsleitung sie entlassen wird.

programme.title: Cheers: Eine Flamme in Florida
programme.desc: Dianes neuer Freund Frasier soll für ein halbes Jahr als Gastdozent nach Bologna. Diane ist begeistert: Frasier will, dass sie ihn begleitet. Dann fällt ihr Sam ein. Trotz der offiziellen Trennung spukt er Diane immer noch im Kopf herum.

programme.title: Cheers: Nachtflug nach Florenz
programme.desc: Sam hat eine neue Kellnerin eingestellt. Sie ist nicht mehr jung, aber dafür eine absolute Perle. Die Gäste sind begeistert. Da kommt ihre hübsche Tochter zu Besuch. Sam ist verrückt nach ihr. Carla verbietet Sam, etwas mit ihr anzufangen.

programme.title: Cheers: Rückfall zu zweit – Teil 1
programme.desc: Nach dem letzten großen Krach mit Diane ist Sam erneut der Flasche verfallen. Diane überredet ihn deshalb, sich auf ein Gespräch mit Dr. Frasier Crane einzulassen. Sam glaubt, Diane wäre wieder in ihn verliebt.

programme.title: Cheers: Rückfall zu zweit – Teil 2

programme.title: Zatím spolu, zatím živi
programme.desc: V akční komedii je Tom Cruise tajným agentem a Cameron Diaz ženou polapenou mezi ním a těmi, kteří ho - podle jeho tvrzení - do této situace dostali. S tím, jak se jejich divoké dobrodružství mění v bludiště podfuků, úniků na poslední chvíli, falešných identit a opojných romantických, ale naprosto zmatených situací, zjišťují, že jediné, na co se mohou spoléhat, jsou oni dva navzájem. Dvojici hvězdných představitelů doplňují ve vedlejších rolích Paul Dano (Až na krev, Malá Miss Sunshine), Viola Davis (Pochyby) či Peter Sarsgaard (Škola života).

programme.title: Generace Matrix
programme.desc: V roce 1999 šokoval celou generaci jedinečný film, který si získal obrovskou popularitu. Zrodila se sága Matrix, která se rychle stala popkulturním fenoménem filmařské dvojice Wachowských. Prorocké aspekty této produkce se staly ústředním tématem dokumentu. Snímek, který diváka vtáhl do 21. století, předjímal mnohé společenské a politické problémy naší doby: využívání technologií, hackerství, genderové záležitosti a otázky identity, falešné zprávy a konspirační teorie.

programme.title: Respect: Královna soulu
programme.desc: Film vypráví výjimečný příběh životní cesty legendární hudební hvězdy Arethy Franklin. Svůj hlas musela prosadit v nesnadných 60. letech minulého století, kdy se Amerika ocitla uprostřed bouřlivého sociálního a politického dění. Výběr herečky, která ji měla ztvárnit ve filmu, schválila ještě samotná pěvecká legenda. Kromě držitelky Oscara Jennifer Hudson (2007, nejlepší herečka ve vedlejší roli "Dreamgirls"), se ve hvězdně obsazeném životopisném snímku představí i držitel Oscara Forest Whitaker (2007, nejlepší herec "Poslední skotský král"), zpěvačka Mary J. Blige či Marlon Wayans.

programme.title: The Wire - Špína Baltimoru
programme.desc: S02E05 Protože Ziggy dluží dealerům za drogy, seberou mu jeho milované auto - červené Camaro. Plukovník Rawls ujistí Bunkse, že ho nechce stáhnout z případu, přestože se vražda nedaří vyšetřit. Bodie řeší potyčku v Pitu kvůli nekvalitním drogám. Detektivové předávají přístavním dělníkům předvolání kvůli místní vraždě. Policajtka Beadie Russellová využívá bývalé náklonnosti jednoho z dělníků a pokouší se zjistit, jak se náklad dostal z přístavu. Objeví se požadavek na spojení případu vraždy s vyšetřováním Franka Sobotky a jeho kolegů z odborů.

programme.title: The Wire - Špína Baltimoru
programme.desc: S02E06 McNulty se ve snaze zachránit svoje manželství rozhodne skoncovat s policejními záležitostmi a vzdá identifikaci Jane Doeové. Detektivové najdou v rámci vyšetřování Sobotkova případu v počítači pravidelnost, která by mohla vést k vraždám. Toto spojení se snaží objasnit Danielsovi a navrhují mu, že by bylo vhodné oba případy spojit. Ten však stále odmítá. Sobotka se jménem svého odboru pokouší rozehrát politickou hru. Nick sežene chemikálie, o které ho žádal Vondas, za což si nechá zaplatit penězi i drogami - připravenými k prodeji. D'Angelo se chce vymanit z Barksdaleova vlivu a Bell si k vyřešení tohohle problému povolá pomoc zvenčí.

programme.title: Teče tudy řeka
programme.desc: Oscarový režisér Robert Redford zachycuje v této uz návané filmové adaptaci autobiografické klasiky Normana Macleana majestátnost montanské divočiny a sílu americké rodiny. Craig Sheffer si zahrál mladého Normana a Brad Pitt jeho protikladného bratra Paula, okouzlujícího rebela, který by chtěl dát celému světu na frak. Rána tráví oba ve škole a studiem náboženství, odpoledne se vydávají k místní řece chytat pstruhy. Během dospívání se Norman s Paulem začnou bouřit proti přísnému otci, který působí jako presbyteriánský kněz. Zatímco Norman ventiluje své emoce psaním a stává se disciplinovaným a přízemním profesorem, svobodomyslný Paul se vydává na dráhu novináře a záhy propadne hazardním hrám a alkoholu

programme.desc: Zadlužený mladý pár předstírá smrtelnou nemoc, aby vybral peníze ve virální sbírce. S přibývajícími dary se jim ale lež vymkne z rukou.

programme.title: Rocky IV
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) pyšně vévodí světovém šampionátu v těžké váze, ale na obzoru se objevuje nový vyzyvatel: Drago (Dolph Lundgren) - skoro dva metry vysoký a 118 kilogramů vážící bojovník, za nímž stojí celý Sovětský svaz. Rocky se za tréninkem vydává až na mrazivou Sibiř, kde se připravuje na zápas, který se odehraje v samotném srdci Moskvy a bude vysílán po celém světě. Ale nic ho nedokáže připravit na to, čemu bude muset čelit ve skutečnosti. Čeká ho krutý boj od začátku až do úplného konce, ve kterém se nebude bít jen za sebe, ale za čest celé své země!

programme.title: Fantastický mazel
programme.desc: Ti je chudý stavební dělník, který se ze všech sil snaží udržet svého synka Dickyho na prestižní soukromé škole. Přestože Ti dělá co může, aby mu zajistil příležitosti, které sám nikdy neměl, Dicky si ve třídě připadá jako odstrkovaný a přehlížený outsider, protože nosí obnošené oblečení a na rozdíl od ostatních spolužáku nevlastní nejnovější elektronické hračky. Jednoho dne Ti najde na skládce tajemného "plyšáka" a spěchá s ním domů za Dickym. Přestože podivný chlupatý tvor na první pohled nevypadá jako obyčejná hračka, když si s ním chlapec začne hrát, ukáže se, že je mnohem, mnohem víc! Tohle není jen průměrná akční figurka, ale živý "mazel" oplývající výjimečnými schopnostmi. Dicky vezme veselého mimozemšťana do školy, aby ho ukázal spolužákům a konečně na ně udělal dojem. Jenže svéhlavý fantastický mazel má vlastní představy o zábavě a situace ve škole se záhy beznadějně vymkne kontrole...

programme.title: Tenkrát v Hollywoodu
programme.desc: V devátém snímku scenáristy a režiséra Quentina Tarantina, odehrávajícím se v Los Angeles roku 1969, se televizní hvězda Rick Dalton (Leonardo DiCaprio) a jeho dlouholetý dablér Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) snaží prosadit v měnící se filmové branži, kterou už sotva poznávají. Film Tenkrát v Hollywoodu přináší pestrou paletu hereckých hvězd i dějových linek, aby složil hold posledním chvílím zlatého věku americké továrny na sny.

programme.title: Muži v černém 3
programme.desc: Agent Jay cestuje v čase zpět do roku 1969, kde se spojí s mladší verzí agenta Kaye a společně se pokusí zastavit ďábelského mimozemšťana dřív, než zničí budoucnost. S třetím dílem snímku Muži v černém se vrací také agent J (Will Smith) a K (Tommy Lee Jones). A vracejí se také v čase! J viděl za patnáct let v tajné službě spoustu nevysvětlitelných věcí, ale co mu vůbec nejde na rozum je jeho zdrženlivý partner. Ovšem když je život agenta K v ohrožení a s ním i osud celé planety, musí J podstoupit dobrodružnou cestu v čase a vše napravit. J zjišťuje, že existují tajemství vesmíru, o kterých mu K nikdy neřekl - tajemství, která vyplynou na povrch, když se J spojí s mladší verzí agenta K (Josh Brolin). Podaří se mu zachránit svého parťáka a osud lidstva?

Ovšem když je život agenta K v ohrožení a s ním i osud celé planety, musí J podstoupit dobrodružnou cestu v čase a vše napravit. J zjišťuje, že existují tajemství vesmíru, o kterých mu K nikdy neřekl - tajemství, která vyplynou na povrch, když se J spojí s mladší verzí agenta K (Josh Brolin). Podaří se mu zachránit svého parťáka a osud lidstva?

programme.title: Loupež na úrovni
programme.desc: Crunch je notorický zloděj, ale rád by začal žít jinak. Když ho bratr přemluví, aby se zúčastnil poslední krádeže v životě, dají dohromady starou partu. Plán se však pomalu začíná hroutit... Crunch Calhoun (Kurt Russell) byl v Polsku se svými kumpány a bratrem Nickym, se kterými okradl místního mafiána o pravý obraz od Van Gogha. Při úprku z města, ale došlo k autonehodě a jeho bratr Nicky byl zatčen. Aby se zachránil, začal s policií spolupracovat a práskl Crunche. Ten pak musel jít na sedm let do vězení. Po pěti a půl roce byl propuštěn na svobodu a vydělává si jako kaskadér na motorce. Jeho bratr Nicky stále krade obrazy. Nicky ukradl obraz mužovi jménem Sunny. Policie chtěla Nickyho chytit, ale on je opět převezl a obraz od George Seurata schoval jinam, takže mu interpol nemohl nic dokázat. Interpolu pomáhá bývalý zloděj uměleckých děl Samuel Winter (Terence Stamp). Crunch je se svým kamarádem Franciem, když v tom za ním přijde člověk jménem Sunny, kterého okradl Nicky....

programme.title: Teče tudy řeka
programme.desc: Oscarový režisér Robert Redford zachycuje v této uz návané filmové adaptaci autobiografické klasiky Normana Macleana majestátnost montanské divočiny a sílu americké rodiny. Craig Sheffer si zahrál mladého Normana a Brad Pitt jeho protikladného bratra Paula, okouzlujícího rebela, který by chtěl dát celému světu na frak. Rána tráví oba ve škole a studiem náboženství, odpoledne se vydávají k místní řece chytat pstruhy. Během dospívání se Norman s Paulem začnou bouřit proti přísnému otci, který působí jako presbyteriánský kněz. Zatímco Norman ventiluje své emoce psaním a stává se disciplinovaným a přízemním profesorem, svobodomyslný Paul se vydává na dráhu novináře a záhy propadne hazardním hrám a alkoholu

programme.title: Když jsi šťastná
programme.desc: Žena, přetížená mateřstvím, vybuchne během nevinné hry na baby groupu–a spustí reakci, kterou nikdo nečekal

programme.title: Rocky IV
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) pyšně vévodí světovém šampionátu v těžké váze, ale na obzoru se objevuje nový vyzyvatel: Drago (Dolph Lundgren) - skoro dva metry vysoký a 118 kilogramů vážící bojovník, za nímž stojí celý Sovětský svaz. Rocky se za tréninkem vydává až na mrazivou Sibiř, kde se připravuje na zápas, který se odehraje v samotném srdci Moskvy a bude vysílán po celém světě. Ale nic ho nedokáže připravit na to, čemu bude muset čelit ve skutečnosti. Čeká ho krutý boj od začátku až do úplného konce, ve kterém se nebude bít jen za sebe, ale za čest celé své země!

S třetím dílem snímku Muži v černém se vrací také agent J (Will Smith) a K (Tommy Lee Jones). A vracejí se také v čase! programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Vítejte v Rekall, ve společnosti, která změní vaše sny ve skutečné vzpomínky. Pro dělníka Douglase Quaida (Colin Farrell), ačkoli má krásnou ženu (Kate Beckinsale), kterou miluje, je výlet skrz jeho mysl perfektní dovolenou – skutečné vzpomínky na sebe v roli superagenta je přesně to, co potřebuje. Jenže procedura se pokazí a Quaid se stane namísto superagentem kořistí… V patách mu bude policejní tým, jenž řídí kancléř Cohaagen (Bryan Cranston), vůdce svobodného světa. Quaid se spojí s bojovnicí patřící k rebelům (Jessica Biel) a společně se vydají najít šéfa odboje (Bill Nighy) a následně zastavit Cohaagena. Hranice mezi fantazií a realitou se stírají a osud světa visí na vlásku, zatímco Quaid objeví svou pravou identitu, pravou lásku a svůj skutečný osud.

programme.title: Gravitace
programme.desc: Oscaroví herci Sandra Bullocková a George Clooney se představí ve skvěle napsaném příběhu zasazeném do hlubokého vesmíru v režii Alfonsa Cuaróna (Potomci lidí). Ryan Stoneová je skvělá lékařka/inženýrka a právě zažívá svou první vesmírnou misi. Společnost jí mimo jiných dělá veterán Matt Kowalsky, který naopak svou kariéru astronauta právě končí. Během rutinní práce mimo základnu se však stane neštěstí, díky kterému se dvojice ocitne uprostřed vesmíru s omezenou dávkou kyslíku a s minimální nadějí na přežití. Děsivé ticho jen dokazuje, že jejich spojení se Zemí bylo definitivně přerušeno a že pomoc nemá kam dorazit. Jejich poslední šancí na záchranu je pokračovat do útrob děsivě prázdné temnoty.

Ještě nikdy v historii nebylo datum tak významné pro tolik kultur a náboženství. 2012 je epické dobrodružství o globálním kataklyzmatu, které přinese konec světa, a vypráví o hrdinském boji všech, co přežili.

programme.title: Zkažená úča
programme.desc: Elizabeth je příšerná učitelka. Dostala kopačky od snoubence, ale má nový objev, bohatého učitele Scotta. A tak se pouští do všelijakých intrik a následky se dotknou jejích studentů i spolupracovníků. Tohle je netradiční forma vzdělávání! Zlatokopka Elizabeth Halsey (Cameron Diaz) pověsila svou kariéru učitelky na střední škole na hřebík v očekávání, že se bude brzy vdávat za svého bohatého snoubence. Jenže on zničehonic zásnuby zruší a nebohá Elizabeth se musí vrátit zpět do školy. Nutno říci, že Elizabeth je nezodpovědná, nekompetentní, kouří marihuanu a absolutně nevěnuje pozornost svým kolegům, natož pak studentům. Během svých hodin promítá studentům ve třídě filmy. Kolegyně Amy Squirrel Elizabeth závidí, nesnáší ji a všemožně se jí vyhýbá. Jednoho dne se Elizabeth setká se suplujícím učitelem Scottem Delacortem, zjistí, že je bohatý a začne s ním flirtovat. Následně se dozví, že má Scott rád velká prsa, a tak se rozhodne podstoupit operaci a dát si silikonové implantáty....

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Po svém posledním triumfu se Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) vrací domů a zjišťuje, že kvůli bezohlednému finančnímu poradci přišel o veškeré peníze. Navíc ho jeho zranění z předchozích bojů donutila opustit ring. A tak se Rocky se svou ženou Adrian (Talia Shire) a synem Rocky Jr. (Sage Stallone) stěhuje tam, kde kdysi začínal - do zašlé a levné čtvrti v jižní Philadelphii. Musí však překonat hluboce zakořeněnou zatrpklost a hořkost, která roste s tím, jak jeho nový svěřenec - mladý boxer Tommy Gunn (Tommy Morrison) získává na kvalitě. Když se Tommy obrátí proti svému učiteli a veřejně ho zesměšní, je Rockymu jasné, že ho čeká ještě jeden souboj.

programme.title: Kingsman: Zlatý kruh
programme.desc: Svět Kingsmanů se poprvé představil ve filmu Kingsman: Tajná služba jako nezávislá, mezinárodní špionážní agentura pracující v hlubokém utajení, jejímž cílem je bezpečný svět. V dalším pokračování Kingsman: Zlatý kruh čelí naši hrdinové novým výzvám. Centrála Kingsmanů je zničena a celý svět se stává rukojmím. Kingsmany čekají nové úkoly i překážky. Spojí se se spřátelenou americkou špionážní organizací Statesman. V novém dobrodružství, v němž si agenti sáhnou až na hranice svých sil a možností, musí obě dvě agentury společnými silami porazit nebezpečného nepřítele a zachránit tak svět.

programme.title: The Wire - Špína Baltimoru
programme.desc: S02E05 Protože Ziggy dluží dealerům za drogy, seberou mu jeho milované auto - červené Camaro. Plukovník Rawls ujistí Bunkse, že ho nechce stáhnout z případu, přestože se vražda nedaří vyšetřit. Bodie řeší potyčku v Pitu kvůli nekvalitním drogám. Detektivové předávají přístavním dělníkům předvolání kvůli místní vraždě. Policajtka Beadie Russellová využívá bývalé náklonnosti jednoho z dělníků a pokouší se zjistit, jak se náklad dostal z přístavu. Objeví se požadavek na spojení případu vraždy s vyšetřováním Franka Sobotky a jeho kolegů z odborů.

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: A performance filled with unforgettable voices and expressiveness.

programme.desc: Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: All your favorite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the concert hall, together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.

programme.title: Puccini - La Boheme
programme.desc: In 2012, Norwegian opera director Stefan Herheim brought Giacomo Puccini's opera La bohème to the stage of the Norwegian National Opera in Oslo; Norwegian conductor Eivind Gullberg Jensen leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the National Opera Oslo.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: Following the life of Clara Schumann, wife of the composer Robert Schumann, revealing her personality from different angles with testimonies from those who knew her, performers of her music and her biographers.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, "Little Russian."

programme.title: Liszt's Concerto No. 1 & Mahler's Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Fifth Symphony; Lukáš Vondráček is the soloist in Liszt's First Piano Concerto.

programme.title: Hatari
programme.desc: Director Howard Hawks reteams with John Wayne, who heads a group of highly skilled professional game hunters in Africa. Only they don’t use bullets – they capture the ferocious big game with strong rope and cameras for zoos and circus attractions.

programme.title: Sands of Iwo Jima
programme.desc: Tough-as-nails career Marine Sergeant John Stryker is greatly disliked by the men of his squad, particularly the combat replacements, for the rigorous training he puts them through.

programme.title: Flying Tigers
programme.desc: John Wayne adds luster to this early WWII film about the famous P-40 Flying Group who soared into battle against the Japanese in defense of China's freedom, Great dogfight scenes!

programme.title: The Fighting Seabees
programme.desc: The construction foreman of a fighting work battalion to be stationed near Japanese lines in the Pacific and a naval commander colleague compete in Washington for a journalist, while preparing to engage the enemy in a massive assault.

programme.title: Island In The Sky
programme.desc: Set after World War II, John Wayne plays Dooley, a former army pilot flying transport missions, who is forced to crash-land his fuel-starved plane on a frozen lake after it strays from its course.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: Romance and suspense ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. Whom can she trust?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case of amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hooterville…and she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Oliver Takes Over The Phone Company
programme.desc: Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some loose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Don't Count Your Tomatoes Before They're Picked
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue to divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Kind Word For The President
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: All in the Family

programme.title: Nawell Madani C'est moi la plus belge !
Comédie Club Tour : Juste pour rire
Comédie Club Tour : Juste pour rire
Génération Guignols
programme.desc: Les Guignols de l'info se sont moqués de tout et de son contraire durant 30 années, de 1988 à 2018 : la politique, le sport, les industries, les stars, la société française d'une manière générale et tous les grands de ce monde en ont fait les frais à un certain moment. Ces marionnettes en latex ont fait longtemps bondir le présentateur PPD, une caricature de l'ex-présentateur de journal télévisé, qui incarnait la conscience de l'émission.

programme.title: Le grand show des humoristes
programme.desc: Ce rendez-vous réunit les plus grandes stars francophone de l'humour, et regroupe les moments les plus marquants du Festival Juste pour rire de Montréal. Pour le plus grand plaisir des téléspectateurs, les sketches cultes, parodies hilarantes et duos inédits formés spécialement pour l'occasion s'enchainent à un rythme rapide.

programme.title: Dédo : Biafine
programme.desc: Entre ses réflexions - sur le métier d'apiculteur, ses difficultés à rester en couple ou sa vision sur l'actualité - et les réactions qu'elles suscitent dans le public, Dédo démontre la force du dialogue et notre besoin de pouvoir continuer à rire, de soi, de tout, ensemble.

programme.title: Roman Frayssinet : Ô delà
programme.desc: Après s'être aventuré "Ô dedans", le deuxième volet de la trilogie de spectacles de Roman Frayssinet invite à aller "Ô delà" pour se détacher et observer la vie de loin pour faire la paix avec elle. C'est un nouveau voyage drôle et surréaliste durant lequel Roman Frayssinet pose son regard sur le monde à la recherche de nuances, de beauté, d'équilibre et surtout de rire.

programme.title: Roman Frayssinet : Ô dedans
programme.desc: Conçu comme le premier spectacle d'une trilogie, O dedans permet à Roman Frayssinet d'exposer sa nouvelle philosophie de vie, débarrassé de ses addictions.

programme.title: Tristan Lucas "Français Content"
programme.desc: Autoproclamé "Français content" , l'humoriste à l'humour faussement nonchalant se moque avec finesse de lui-même, des bobos, de la quête de sens et des contradictions de l'époque contemporaine. Sans tabou, il s'attaque aux sujets les plus sensibles, convaincu que l'humour constitue un formidable espace de réflexion.

programme.title: Félix Dhjan : Nuances
programme.desc: Pensionnaire du Jamel Comedy Club, Félix Dhjan se joue du monde moderne avec un style très singulier, un subtil mélange de rire et de réflexion sur des sujets aussi profonds que décalés. Par exemple, est-ce qu'on était aussi complexé avant l'invention du miroir ? ou encore : du chimpanzé à Elon Musk : en quoi avons-nous progressé ?

programme.title: Alexandre Kominek : Bâtard sensible
programme.desc: C'est un Polonais Tunisien né en Suisse : Ce pourrait être le début d'une blague, il a donc décidé d'en faire un spectacle. Alexandre Kominek avance sans chercher à arrondir les angles. Son humour frontal met à nu les contradictions contemporaines comme le désir, la masculinité ou les rapports sociaux. Pendant 1 heure et 45 minutes, il assomme son public à coups d'histoires aussi folles qu'authentiques.

programme.title: Saturday Night Live
programme.desc: La présentation, le monologues et les sketches de Jalen Brunson, Dakota Johnson, Shane Gillis ou encore Inde Navarrette sont les temps forts de cette 52e saison du mythique rendez-vous humoristique "Saturday Night Live", agrémenté de nombreux numéros musicaux, notamment interprétés par Katseye, Turnstile, Rosalie, ou encore Gracie Abrams.

programme.title: Saturday Night Live

programme.title: Sur place ou à emporter ? - Saison 1
programme.desc: Décidés à réussir, l'un dans la gastronomie, l'autre dans le business, Boriss et Samy ouvrent un kebab dans leur ville. Malgré une débordante envie de bien faire et des idées à n'en plus finir, leur établissement ne rencontre pas le succès escompté. Accompagnés avec sarcasme par PV, client de la première heure, ils jonglent ensemble entre audace et échec.

programme.title: Chers parents
programme.desc: Lorsque Jeanne et Vincent demandent à leurs enfants de les rejoindre d'urgence pour leur faire une importante annonce, Pierre, Jules et Louise accourent sur le champ, inquiets et craignant le pire. La nouvelle que leur annoncent leurs parents va faire voler en éclats la belle unité familiale.

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: “Frasier” este un sitcom american produs de televiziunea NBC. S-a intins pe 11 sezoane, intre anii 1993 si 2004, avand 265 de episoade. Dupa divortul de sotia sa, doctorul Frasier Crane (Kelsey Grammer) se intoarce in orasul natal, Seattle. Viata sa de celibatar se complica in momentul in care este obligat sa-l ia in ingrijire pe tatal sau, Martin Crane (John Mahoney), un fost ofiter de politie. Cei doi locuiesc impreuna cu Daphne Moon (Jane Leeves), cea care are grija de Martin. Din ferici

Dupa divortul de sotia sa, doctorul Frasier Crane (Kelsey Grammer) se intoarce in orasul natal, Seattle. Viata sa de celibatar se complica in momentul in care este obligat sa-l ia in ingrijire pe tatal sau, Martin Crane (John Mahoney), un fost ofiter de politie. Cei doi locuiesc impreuna cu Daphne Moon (Jane Leeves), cea care are grija de Martin. Din ferici

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando una estudiante universitaria desaparece, sus compañeros de clase estaban preocupados por la seguridad de ella y la de ellos.

programme.desc: Un joven sano muere misteriosamente mientras duerme y las pruebas de toxicología revelan una dosis letal de lidocaína en su sangre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2002, una pequeña comunidad en el norte del estado de Nueva York quedó devastada cuando Patty Wlasiuk murió en un accidente de camión.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En la búsqueda del asesino de dos adolescentes de Texas, un perfil de conducta llevó a sospechar de Jason Massey. La ciencia demostró que el perfil era correcto y Massey fue ejecutado mediante inyección letal el 3 de Abril del 2001.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La escena del crimen estaba inundada de sangre, lo que hablaba del horror del crimen: el asesinato de dos niños pequeños y el apuñalamiento de su madre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Este episodio documenta un atentado mortal en una iglesia en Oakwood, Illinois, en diciembre de 1997.

programme.desc: Muere un atleta de secundaria, luego de que lo atropellaran y se dieran a la fuga. Todos en el pueblo lamentaron su muerte. Encontrar al asesino era muy poco probable.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El cuerpo de una atractiva joven fue encontrado a una milla de su auto abandonado.

programme.desc: Un hombre que iba en bicicleta resultó herido de muerte y la policía creía que había sido víctima de un accidente de atropello y fuga.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.title: Deadly Women

programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Prayers and Mace
programme.desc: Both brother Tim and fellow Honolulu bondsman James need Dog's help to track down their hard to find fugitives. The two cases on the docket today are challenging, especially the hunt for Gregory, a felon with a lengthy rap sheet.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: New Dog in Town
programme.desc: It's Beth's birthday and Dog knows just what she needs. He surprises Beth with Delilah, a puppy small enough to sit in the palm of her hand. Beth is so happy that she insists on taking the puppy with her on today's bounty.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Trick or Treat
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and before Dog and Beth can help the kids carve their pumpkins, they have some business to attend to. It involves knocking on doors and meeting the neighbors but instead of hunting for treats they're on the search for a fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Girl Trouble
programme.desc: Dog and the team have girl trouble in this case. Krystal jumped bail and seems to have vanished into the high plains of Colorado. To make matters worse, she's running with her lover (and bond co-signer) Carrie. But Thelma and Louise they ain't.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Seeing the Light
programme.desc: Today Leland and Dog make a quick visit to the police supply store to get some new gadgets for the team but they can't linger because they've also got a fugitive to catch. Their target is reputed to have an explosive temper.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: When a Stranger Calls
programme.desc: When an offender with a long record ducks his day in court, Bobby Brown knows whom to call - The Dog!? And knowing that few souls can resist Beth's clever persuasion, Dog gives her the job of luring the fugitive in.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Island Hopper
programme.desc: When a brother bondsman from Washington State calls Dog for help tracking a runner in search of fun in the sun on the tropical paradise of Kauai, the team gets on the case. Dog's only problem? No leads!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Nice Guys Finish Last
programme.desc: Dog and team help out a bondsman friend whose client jumped bail, but the target is a blank slate. Are his tattoos gang related? Is he likely to be violent? And making matters worse, when they hit his apartment they learn he is moving out.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Back Behind Bars
programme.desc: While tracking down a potentially dangerous ex-con facing a five year stretch in the big house, Leland struggles to find time to train and compete for his first boxing match in years.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Family Man
programme.desc: Dog and family head to Kona to track down a wanted father who's looking to bolt to the mainland to evade sentencing. Meanwhile, Dog does some evading of his own - Avoiding the much dreaded birthday party!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: All in the Family
programme.desc: Dog and the team need to help Leland hunt down some elusive fugitives. The case is a family affair with both mother and daughter in trouble with the law.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mother Courage
programme.desc: Dog knows that crime and drugs not only damage victims but also harm the families of the perpetrators, especially the kids. And both of the fugitives he's chasing today have left shattered families and struggling women in their wake.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bounty Boot Camp
programme.desc: Jim is a bondsman and longtime friend of Dog. Jim's son has just started in the family business. Today, Jim has asked Dog to track down a potentially dangerous fugitive, and take his son along for some training with the best in the world.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Friends and Neighbors
programme.desc: Dog and his posse head to Colorado for a special mission, to catch Marco, an alleged drug dealer. It's been ten months since Marco went on the lam, and his bondsman stands to lose his family business if Marco is not caught.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Set-Up
programme.desc: The trail is hot and the stakes is high for Dog and the posse. The "Big Fish" in this case is Marco, an alleged drug dealer with a big bond. But a major key to catching him is Elizabeth, who is also a fugitive from the law.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Searchers
programme.desc: Dog is still on the search for the elusive fugitive, Marco. Dog has been tracking him across Colorado, from Grand Junction to Denver, and now a hot tip that a long time associate of his is hiding in Pueblo sends the team racing south.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Buddha's Delight
programme.desc: Dog and the posse travel to the Big Island to help Leland track down a small-time Bonnie and Clyde couple. Their crime: theft, including allegedly stealing a pair of Buddha statues for resale.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Three's Company
programme.desc: This fugitive is hard to pin down in Honolulu's downtown district, moving from hostel to hotel to apartment high-rise. But as the hunt evolves, Dog discovers that this alleged burglar isn't the only family member wanted by the law.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Strip Search
programme.desc: When a stripper goes on the lam, Dog has to bring her in. It's a tough job but somebody has to do it. Thankfully for the team, Lady Luck is presiding over the posse tonight.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Secret Places
programme.desc: When Leland learns that one of his clients with a reputation for stealing has lost her co-signer and could be ready to run, Dog and the crew hop a plane to the Big Island.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Wrong Turn
programme.desc: Dog's target today seems to have a taste for drugs and a record of reckless driving. The hunt has deep emotional resonance for the team because today is the anniversary of the fatal car accident of Dog's daughter Barbara Katie.

programme.title: Taylor Mason
programme.desc: Taylor Mason is your average, run-of-the-mill writer, performer, singer-songwriter, ventriloquist, comedian, entertainer, rock'n'roller, puppeteer, pianist, entertainer, and is here now for Dry Bar Comedy.

programme.title: Michael Joiner
programme.desc: Michaelís brand of comedy is, in a word, familiar. Not in the sense that youíve heard it before, but more so that he knows you and you know him. He speaks about the things you are thinking in a way that sounds so much like your inner voice it is astounding. His effortless delivery will resonate with you. Michael is the 1st Place winner of the Hollywood Improv's "FUNNIEST COMIC IN L.A." 2008, and 2010 Christian Music Hall of Fame "COMEDIAN OF THE YEAR" nominee, Joiner has attracted wide praise for his routines that blend a sarcastic edginess with a devotion to clean humor. Joiner has headlined at The LA AREA Improvs, The Funny Bone, The Ice House and other comedy clubs across the country while also performing at colleges and sold out Clean Comedy Concerts nationwide. He's also written for "The Tonight Show With Jay Leno." He has been performing nationwide for over 25 years and is rated one of the nation's funniest Clean Stand-up Comedians. The TV Guide Network calls Michael "One of the funniest, most original, stand up Comedians working today!" In 2006, Michael was one out of only four Comedians chosen worldwide to star in the top selling DVD, "The Clean Stand Up Comedy Tour." Unlike many Comedians who stick to their rehearsed script, Michael's stand up comedy show includes some of the most clever, hilarious improv and audience interaction you will ever experience.

programme.title: Christian Pieper
programme.desc: Christian Pieper is an award-winning and crowd-pleasing comedian from Beaver Dam, Kentucky, now living in Los Angeles. In just five years as a performer, Christian has quickly earned acclaim for his honest, smart, and welcoming approach to personal material, layering unexpectedly subversive observations on current events, culture, and relationships.A two-time semifinalist in the prestigious Boston Comedy Festival, hes also been featured in the Crossroads Comedy Festival, Burbank Comedy Festival, and other festivals and competitions across the country. Christian has also performed abroad, having done shows for troops and civilians in eight different countries, and was a guest on the Bob & Tom show. He currently hosts and produces Adrenaline, a comedy-challenge show presented regularly at Wiseguys Comedy Club in Salt Lake City and the Hollywood Improv.

programme.title: Leland Klassen
programme.desc: Raised on a farm in the heart of Canada, Leland quickly learned that shoveling manure and weeding potatoes, although lucrative, wasnít his passion in life. So with absolutely no clear direction or vision for his future, he did what everyone does when they find themselves in that position - he went to University. He wisely chose his classes based on whichever cute girl happened to catch his attention and after several short years of last minute cramming and late assignments, Leland graduated from the University of Saskatchewan with a degree in Anthropology. As you might have guessed, Lelandís university education opened many doors for him in the years to come, but for some reason he was dissatisfied working for a courier as a night shift stock boy. By this time married and with his first child soon on the way, the most responsible and obvious choice was, of course, to pursue a career in the entertainment industry. Starting off at amateur nights and seedy bars Leland decided right from the beginning that he would remain clean despite what everyone else was doing and as a result over the last 16 years Leland has become recognized as Canadaís premier clean comedian. With his unique intelligence and wit, Leland has carved out quite a niche for himself in the world of entertainment. Using his farm boy charm and handsome (although somewhat inbred) Mennonite good looks, Lelandís clever observations and rich life experiences are brought to life in a one-of-a-kind show. LELANDíS CREDITS: Halifax Comedy Fest 2014, Just for Laughs in Montreal, 1999, 2001, 2004 and 2014, Host of Popcorn TV, Featured on Thou Shalt Laugh 5, Host of Comedy Tournament, Co-Host GMA Canada 2009, 2012 and 2013, Promise Keepers Canada, Episode of the US syndicated comedy series ìBananasî, Two of his own television seriesí on the West Coast, as well as Appeared on numerous other programs across the United States and Canada, such as Comedy Network, CBC Television, YTV, Star TV, Global and Discovery Kids.

programme.title: Jason Hewlett
programme.desc: The Award-Winning One-Man Show of Jason Hewlett The Entertainer will have you laughing until it hurts. Comedy, Music, Impressions, and Standing Ovations make Jason the perfect entertainer. His brand of Hilarious G-Rated Entertainment is unlike anything you have ever enjoyed. Over 2,000 shows for more than 1 Million audience members in his incredible career make Jasonís show an event you will remember for years to come.

programme.title: XTERRA Adventures
programme.desc: S01E08 XTERRA is the world's premier off-road multisport event. An extreme competition, the XTERRA format combines swimming with mountain biking and trail running. It has been described as one part triathlon, one part mountain bike race, and one part "survival of the fittest". The typical distances are a 1.5k swim, 30k mountain bike, and 10k trail run.

programme.title: Salomon Gore - Tex Maxi Race
programme.desc: More than just a trail-race the Maxi Race takes runners on an 85km journey around the unique landscape of Lake Annecy, France. Athletes choose the Ultra, Vertical-Race or Marathon, pushing themselves to develop mountain skills and face their own personal challenges. The Salomon Gore-Tex Maxi Race is one of the best and most demanding trail running events, staged in the stunning lake and mountain scenery of the Haute Savoie.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E09 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E09 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Qatar Cross Country Rally - 2020
programme.desc: Manateq Qatar Cross-Country Rally signaled the opening round of the FIA World Cup for Cross-Country Rallies at the stunning, awe-inspiring state of Qatar. Organised by the Qatar Motor and Motorcycle Federation (QMMF), the event has attracted 33 teams and competitors from 17 nations. Five days of intense competition and 1,444.99 kilometres in the challenging Qatar desert, will test cars and drivers to their limits. Although the event has attracted many teams and competitors, the 3-time Dakar winner Nasser Saleh Al-Attiyah stands out prominently. Al-Attiyah has proven to be a force to be reckoned within the cross-country rally scene. Only just missing the mark in the last Dakar Rally, the born and bred Qatari will be keen to compete and impress on home soil.

programme.title: World Marathon Challenge
programme.desc: 2020 World Marathon Challenge began on the continent of Africa, on February 6th. The Africa Intercontinental Marathon commenced on the scenic Seapoint Promenade. Unlike other years, the Antarctica Intercontinental Marathon was the second rather than first of the seven marathons this year. Perth, Dubai, Madrid, Fortaleza and a finish in Miami followed this as unique as described World Marathon Challenge. Seven continents in seven days - and the Challenge has completed successfully!
